==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Tongtong:''' The Liondance is dancing...
:'''Tongtong:''' One step, two steps, three steps... Step by step on the plum piles!
:{{DIcon}} You're really into liondance, aren't you?
:'''Tongtong:''' Yes! It's my favorite performance!
:'''Tongtong:''' See? The mane on that lion's head swaying in the wind. And the eyes shine like two diamonds!
:'''Tongtong:''' When I grow up, I want to learn the liondance from [[Lingyang]]!
{{Dialogue End}}
